OFAST-X: WORDPRESS.ORG REPO-READY CHECKLIST
==========================================

This checklist outlines the specific adjustments needed to pass the manual human review at WordPress.org.

1. PREFIXING (NO CONFLICTS)
---------------------------
The repository requires that EVERY function, class, and global variable be uniquely prefixed.
[x] Classes: Using Ofast_X_... naming is good.
[ ] Functions: Ensure every standalone function starts with ofast_x_ (e.g., in ofast-x.php).
[ ] CSS/JS Handles: Every wp_enqueue_script/style handle must be prefixed (e.g., 'ofast-x-admin-css').
[ ] Database Options: Every get_option/update_option key must be prefixed (e.g., 'ofast_x_settings').

2. SECURITY & DATA HANDLING (THE "BIG THREE")
---------------------------------------------
[ ] Sanitization: Every $_POST, $_GET, and $_REQUEST variable must be sanitized before use.
    - Use sanitize_text_field(), intval(), absint(), or sanitize_email().
[ ] Validation: Check types and values before saving (e.g., only save 'yes' or 'no').
[ ] Escaping on Output: EVERY time you echo data from the database, it must be escaped.
    - esc_html() for text.
    - esc_attr() for HTML attributes.
    - esc_url() for links.
    - NOTE: Reviewers want to see "Late Escaping" (echo esc_html($var);).

3. NONCE SECURITY
-----------------
[ ] Every form submission must have a wp_nonce_field.
[ ] Every URL action (like a 'Delete' link) must have a wp_nonce_url.
[ ] Every action hook must verify the nonce using wp_verify_nonce() or check_admin_referer().

4. UI AND BRANDING RULES
------------------------
[ ] No Intrusive Upselling: Links to Pro versions are allowed in sidebars or an 'Account' page, but cannot be large banners at the top of every admin page.
[ ] Clean UI: Do not "break" the WordPress admin experience with overly custom styles that hide standard WP elements.
[ ] Branding: Ensure all references are unique to your plugin. (Remove any 'Post SMTP' or other plugin names found in the UI).

5. CODE CLEANUP
---------------
[ ] Move Inline Styles/Scripts: Large blocks of CSS/JS inside PHP functions should be moved to .css and .js files and enqueued properly.
[ ] No Obfuscated Code: All code must be human-readable (no base64 encoding of logic).
[ ] No Phoning Home: Do not call external APIs or track user data without explicit user consent (usually via an opt-in).

6. METADATA
-----------
[ ] README.txt: Required in 'Standard Markdown' format. This generates your WordPress.org plugin page.
[ ] LICENSE: Ensure the root LICENSE file clearly states 'GPLv2 or later'.

------------------------------------------
PATH RECOMMENDATION:
- Single binary: One plugin with Free + Pro features.
- Pro features unlocked via license key from ofastshop.com.
- See LICENSING_GUIDE.md for full architecture details.
------------------------------------------
